# September 2026

A month that was meant to end in a decision on the second site and ended instead with two clear conditions. Everything else was autumn preparation.

## The second site

Pellow Mutual's loan offer arrived on 8 September ([[pellow-mutual-loan-offer-2026-09-08|the offer]]), which made the question real. Ruth and I worked through the [[cash-buffer-calculation-2026-09|buffer calculation]] before the review. On 14 September I opened the [[central-production-kitchen|central production idea]], and Kofi answered it by email and then in person on 24 September: no 03:00 starts, and the bakers will propose their own pattern by mid-November. See [[recaps/daily/2026/2026-09-24|24 September]].

At the [[second-site-review-2026-09-30|review on 30 September]] Ruth advised waiting for a three-month cash buffer and Kofi repeated his objection. I deferred the decision to 15 December, before the unit 7 option expires on the 19th. It remains open in [[should-we-open-a-second-site|the question note]]. See [[recaps/daily/2026/2026-09-30|30 September]].

## Christmas, butter and the pavement

The [[christmas-preorder-planning-2026-09-22|Christmas planning meeting]] set a target of 320 orders with the deposit kept at 30%; orders open on 1 October. The [[dairy-contract-renegotiation|dairy renegotiation]] started at the beginning of the month as butter reached 8.90 EUR a kilo. The pavement licence application for 2027 went in on 21 September ([[pavement-licence-application-submitted-2026-09-21|submission]]).

## The team

Hana finished her first month on the early shift and ran her own section of the bake from early September. Kofi's hours are coming down but are not yet under 42.

## Carried into October

The Glenvarrow fixed-price offer, a second dairy quote, Christmas orders, and the bakers' production proposal.
